acceptanceCriteria: Make --help a read-only OK outcome for every recognized subcommand, with that command usage/flags and relevant reason codes and release handoff preconditions.

Preserve mutation payload help fields, malformed non-help behavior and unsupported-command execution limits; prove help consumes no stdin, opens no queue locks and writes no state in absent and initialized repositories.
Retain meaningful command-inventory and actual disposable CLI qualification, focused checks and independent review; keep open until verified integration and native submit/gate/completion succeed.
body:
Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/422
Direct owner requested fixing newly filed GitHub tickets on 2026-10-01 in the ongoing all-issues batch. Preserve original complete issue intent below. Independent baseline confirms the reported behavior; no source repair or live policy/store migration performed. Core rc.1 build163; Tasks developer build202.

## Summary

Per-command `--help` is inconsistent in `corvint-tasks` (main @ d693d28). External agents learn flags by trying `--help`. When it errors, they guess flags or read source, and in our queue the guessing has cost retries.

## Observed

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `corvint-tasks ticket create --help` (and other `ticket` mutations) | OK: operation and `payloadKeys` |
| `corvint-tasks policy update` (no args) | usage text in warnings |
| `corvint-tasks plan preview --help` | `ERROR`, warning `unknown plan flag` |
| `corvint-tasks release --help` | `ERROR` `MALFORMED: argv: unknown flag --help` |
| `corvint-tasks submit --help` | `ERROR` `MALFORMED: argv: unknown flag --help` |

Top-level `corvint-tasks help` lists usage lines. It doesn't list the `--reason` values that `release` accepts for hand-offs, though `HANDOFF` and `REVIEW_RETURNED` do appear in the general `releaseReasonCodes` list.

## Request

Make `--help` a read-only, `OK` outcome for every subcommand. Return that command's usage, flags and, where relevant, its accepted reason codes. `release` should spell out its hand-off preconditions (see #421).


## Observed public-main composition after PRs #424 and #416

Both PRs merged on 2026-10-01: #424 -> 6404cf0c8c7697ab7463de0dde6e9df7b5cabaa5, then #416 -> c4de689ae51e2e4fb4e27b6250e6349e72196340. The current source at c4de689a/tree183c1cecf3084823e9143bb284ad175733f51fe2 recognizes criterion-binding capture/verify in ReadVerbs but lacks their commandUsage entries. Exact existing TestCALV0047_AllCommandHelpIsReadOnly failed on criterion-binding capture --help with ERROR: capture requires unique --ticket and --attempt (command_help_test.go:38). Verify is separately source-confirmed missing; the inventory test stops at capture. No product source edited during diagnosis. Core163/Tasks202 release freshness rechecked; reproduction uses current immutable source with local Go1.27.1, not a newly qualified installed release.

Expected: both leaves return read-only OK help with their actual usage, capture flags and canonical stdin descriptions, preserving absent/initialized queue bytes and not consuming stdin. This is the existing ticket all-recognized-command requirement, so deduplication retained this ticket rather than creating a competing work item. Original three acceptance criteria remain unchanged.

Retained evidence: /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/tasks-420-422/integration-baseline-summary.json, integration-help-baseline.log and integration-preflight-plan.md. Prior #424 receipts cannot substitute execution on the composed tree. Remaining closeout: surgical help repair, fresh focused composition checks and independent review, post-commit dogfood CEM binding/check/seal, publication/integration and native submit/gate/completion/readback/audit.
title: GH #422: corvint-tasks: --help works for ticket mutations and policy update but errors for plan preview, release, submit and other lease commands
